name: Beninu
title: Levite Who Sealed the Covenant
summary: Beninu was a Levite who lived in the period after the Babylonian exile. He is mentioned as one of the Levites who placed his seal on the covenant with God under Nehemiah's leadership, when the people committed themselves to follow God's law after returning to Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Sealing of the Covenant
keyEvents.description: Beninu was among the Levites who placed their seal on the covenant with God, where the people committed themselves to keep the Lord's law given through Moses.

keyEvents.title: The People's Renewal of the Covenant
keyEvents.description: As part of a larger assembly, Beninu participated in the solemn renewal of the covenant between God and Israel after returning from exile.

keyEvents.title: The Role of the Levites in the Covenant Renewal
keyEvents.description: The Levites, including Beninu, played a central role in the spiritual renewal of the people of Israel during Nehemiah's governorship.

keyEvents.title: The Community Pledges to Keep the Law
keyEvents.description: Along with the others who sealed the covenant, Beninu committed to follow all of God's commands, statutes and laws, and to remain separate from the surrounding peoples.
